$comment:
host → published Agent Preview page. DERIVED — never hand-edited.
Regenerate with `node previews/build-host-map.mjs` in the mva repo; that script
carries the full rationale for every rule below. Source of truth is the six
committed previews/build-report-<segment>.json files, nothing else.

PURPOSE. A buyer who types their domain into the diagnostic on /get-agent-ready/
can be shown their own preview page, so their purchase carries a slug through to
Stripe instead of parking in unmatched_payments awaiting a hand-match.

THE ONE RULE: REFUSE RATHER THAN GUESS. A wrong match sells a merchant another
merchant's page and delivers another merchant's private agent-readiness review —
the one mistake here that no refund walks back. There is no fuzzy matching, no
partial matching and no ranking in this file. Every host that cannot be resolved
to exactly one page is in `ambiguous` with its candidates, so a caller can ask
'which of these is you?' rather than fail silently or guess.

HOW TO USE IT. Look up the www-stripped, lowercased host of what the buyer typed.
  matchable[host]            → one page. tie_broken:false means the host resolved
                               outright; tie_broken:true means several pages share
                               the host and this is the only one at its bare root.
  matchable[host].candidates → present only when tie_broken. The pages this one
                               beat. SHOW THEM. The root winner is reliably the
                               right HOST and is not always the right ENTITY:
                               fantasyspringsresort.com resolves to the resort spa
                               over seven of its own restaurants, and sensei.com
                               resolves to a restaurant over the resort.
  ambiguous[host]            → several pages, no unique root. NOT a match. Offer
                               the list or offer nothing; never pick one.
  neither                    → no match. Say so plainly.

ALWAYS CONFIRM WITH name + city BEFORE ACTING. A host lookup is an inference; the
buyer confirming 'yes, that's my business' is what turns it into consent. That
confirmation is not decoration — it is the control that makes tie_broken entries
and single-page national brands (24hourfitness.com resolves to the one Indio gym)
safe to offer at all.

FETCH THIS LAZILY — only after the diagnostic returns, never on page load. It is
~43 KB gzipped against a 50 KB page, and nobody who does not run the diagnostic
should pay for it.

`path` IS CARRIED BECAUSE THE SLUG DOES NOT IMPLY THE SEGMENT. Build the URL from
`path`, never by joining a slug to a guessed category. Tie-break groups cross
segments routinely — fantasyspringsresort.com's winner is in wellness-healthcare
while the seven it beat are in food-dining. Inferring that one cost a 404 during
the recon that produced this file.

NORMALIZATION, AND A KNOWN DEPARTURE FROM CANON. Hosts are keyed with
core/playbook/tools/lib/urlkey.py's host_key: lowercased, www stripped as a
prefix, port preserved. That module labels host_key 'A ROLLUP DIMENSION, NEVER A
JOIN KEY', because two distinct pages on one host are two rows and keying by host
silently merges them. THIS FILE USES IT AS A JOIN KEY ANYWAY — deliberately, and
only because the merge is never silent here: every collision either resolves to a
unique bare root (tie_broken, candidates attached) or is refused into `ambiguous`.
The warning is about silent merging, and nothing in this file merges silently.

WHY www IS COLLAPSED, WHICH LOOKS LIKE THE LESS SAFE CHOICE. Preserving www would
yield 977 matchable hosts instead of 960, and 17 of those extra matches are the
dangerous ones. Seven hosts hold two different businesses split only by the www
prefix — www.brandinitoffee.com is the Palm Springs store, brandinitoffee.com is
Rancho Mirage — and under strict host equality BOTH resolve 'cleanly' while the
prefix silently decides which business you sold. Collapsing www turns all seven
into ambiguous groups that refuse correctly. A smaller map that cannot make that
mistake beats a larger one that can.

EXCLUDED BY CONSTRUCTION: 204 published pages whose census row carries no website,
and the two slugs withdrawn 2026-08-08 (inn-at-palm-springs,
fantasy-springs-resort-casino) whose canonical URLs now 404. The withdrawn pair is
absent from published_rows already; the generator asserts it rather than filtering.

normalization.rule: core/playbook/tools/lib/urlkey.py host_key (v1): scheme forced, host lowercased, leading 'www.' stripped as a prefix, duplicate slashes collapsed, trailing slash removed
normalization.note: see $comment — host_key is documented as a rollup dimension, not a join key; the tie_broken/ambiguous branches are what make this use of it safe
